title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper… (CVE-2026-80505)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain an improper access control vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially disclose sensitive information. The vulnerability is classified as high severity with a CVSS score of 7.3.
